result.summary: Several layout and styling issues: truncated restaurant names and category chips, a likely overlapping status/profile control, and a cut-off promotional card at the bottom.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, cutting off the name and part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels fully show the last visible card or add peek/padding so names and images are not truncated.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding or allow the chip row to scroll fully so all labels are fully visible.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant promo card is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards are fully visible when scrolling.

issues.description: The circular control in the top-right (profile/notifications) appears to overlap or sit too close to the status-bar area, with a small red badge that may be hard to tap or see.
issues.suggestion: Give the header more top padding and ensure the badge is fully inside a tappable hit target.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without ellipsis treatment that still communicates the full name.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent ellipsis or two-line wrapping so names remain readable.
